meta_description: Escape to 107 Sunflower Street, a 5-bedroom WaterColor vacation rental with a carriage house, screened porch, golf cart, and nature-preserve views. Book here!
description_expanded:
107 Sunflower Street | Crossings District | Watercolor

107 Sunflower Street, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Located in the Crossings District of Watercolor, sits a serene coastal home 107 Sunflower Street. This vacation rental home offers 5 bedrooms + Carriage House, 5 ½ bathrooms, a golf cart/LSV and an incredible screened porch with a green space the kids will enjoy!

107 Sunflower sits on a quiet street in Watercolor with beautiful views of the nature preserve. This residence welcomes you with manicured landscaping and an inviting front porch. The first floor of the home offers a calming, yet elevating interior with an open floor plan for all to enjoy. From the cozy living room to the stylish dining room that can seat 12 guests, you will find the chef's kitchen. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances including a beverage fridge and ice maker, plenty of countertop space, and bar stool seating for 4 guests. Next you will find the master bedroom with a king size bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. There is a half bathroom on this floor.

The second floor offers a sitting space with a comfortable couch and tv. The first bedroom on this floor offers a king size bed and a private bathroom. The next guest bedroom has a king size bed and private bathroom. Then you have a guest bedroom that offers two queen beds with a private bathroom. There is a bunk space with two twin over twin bunk beds.

The screened-in porch and outdoor space of this home is perfect for all to gather around. The porch offers comfortable seating to enjoy the big game or for meal time. The carriage house has a private entrance and offers a little extra space. The carriage house has a king size bed, private bathroom, sitting space, and small kitchenette.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart/LSV per address- you may not rent a second cart/LSV if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart/LSV rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart/LSV rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts/LSVs.

- 14 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
